# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLUME_SPIKE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A weak opening-range break accompanied by below-average volume often reverses, offering a short-bias fade. The edge exists because low-volume breakdowns lack conviction and are prone to mean reversion, especially when VIX is elevated (>22) and avoiding the first 15 minutes after open reduces noise from opening imbalances.

## Mechanism

Entry: If price breaks below the opening-range low (first 30-min high/low) on a 5-minute bar and that bar’s volume is less than 0.6× the average volume of the first five 5-minute bars of the session, enter short at the close of that bar.  
Exit: Stop placed at the opening-range high; target set at 1× risk (distance from entry to stop) or at VWAP if reached earlier. Avoid entries in the first 15 minutes after open. Only consider when VIX > 22.
